title: OCR result, format 1
description: The text of one image as every OCR engine and place returns it (transcribe-go internal/ocr, copied into Moliri server/transcribe). Boxes are [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the image that was read; the page's width and height scale them to any size.

engine.description: Place, engine and version, separated by colons: desktop:tesseract-5.0.0, server:tesseract-5.3.0, browser:tesseract.js, ai:gemini-2.5-pro.

language.description: Models or languages used, e.g. deu+frak2021.

layout.description: How the page was segmented: auto, lines, block, sparse.

line.description: One line in reading order. Engines without word boxes give words without bbox or no words; the editor then marks the line.

p.description: Confidence of the whole line, when its words have none.

word.description: One word of a line. Engines without confidence (Windows OCR) leave p out; readers take the word as certain.
